column1: # Tribuna doc_id -> decision_id for every SZ Kantonsgericht portal document already held in the corpus.
# Verified 2026-11-25: all 3,508 portal rows listed with the scraper's own GWT-RPC calls (3,456 dockets,
# every one held). For the 50 dockets carrying several documents, each document's text was compared with
# the held record (8-word shingles, then letter ratio): 24 re-uploads of a held ruling map onto it here;
# 28 further documents (Berichtigungen, earlier Beschlüsse, Kurzbegründung/reasoned pairs) are left out
# so the scraper fetches them under "<docket>-T<doc_id[:8]>" with the date they state.
